description: Reopen a Submitted or Approved timesheet period for corrections. The period and its time reports revert to Rejected (editable), allowing the reporter to edit and resubmit. Use this when an approved period needs fixing. An optional comment can be provided. Use confirm=true to proceed. Requires Manager or Admin/Owner role (Finance is excluded — timesheet approval is PM work, not finance).

comment.description: Optional comment explaining why the period is being reopened. Shown to the reporter.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

submission_period_id.description: Id of the submission period to reopen (from get_pending_approvals or list_approval_history).

name: reopen_timesheet
